_doc: Fable cold read, round 3, 10 leaves (seed 20260907) from tough_leaves.txt excluding rounds 1-2. Page fractions, eyeballed ~0.01. Labels are a reader's judgement, NOT gold. New codes beyond rounds 1-2: XP off-page pixels (scanner surround, book edge) · AP adjacent-page bleed (the facing leaf's ink visible at the edge) · ST show-through (ghost of the verso) · CT crop-truncation (text runs off the scan edge). Also CR now observed on BOTH sides: it sits at the GUTTER side, PN at the fore-edge, on every NT leaf so far.
